intro: Today's headlines highlight massive infrastructure expansions and a new push for transparency in AI safety. Companies are also deepening their integration of specialized AI tools into both enterprise workflows and academic research.

must_know.title: The full stack behind abundant intelligence
must_know.summary: OpenAI is pursuing a full-stack infrastructure strategy to support AI development, including a new 1GW data center project in Michigan. The initiative focuses on scaling compute capacity and hardware to increase accessibility and manage costs for AGI development.
must_know.why_it_matters: Massive infrastructure investments are critical for the next generation of model scaling.

must_know.title: Anthropic is letting METR researchers look under the hood with employee-level access
must_know.summary: Anthropic has granted METR researchers internal access to its systems to perform independent assessments, relinquishing the company's power to block findings on risks and safety.
must_know.why_it_matters: This move toward transparency with external oversight is a significant development in AI safety and auditing practices.

must_know.title: Meta and Apple team up to make Muse AI models run better on Macs
must_know.summary: Meta announced 'Muse Spark,' an open-weight AI model optimized to run locally on Apple silicon via the MLX framework, specifically demonstrating performance on dual M5 Ultra Mac Studios.
must_know.why_it_matters: Optimizing frontier-class open models for local hardware allows for broader research accessibility.

foundation-models.title: The next phase of enterprise AI
foundation-models.summary: OpenAI reports an acceleration in enterprise AI adoption, with organizations shifting from early experimentation to integrating AI agents and specialized models for productivity gains. Data from 2025 shows deeper business integration across industries.
foundation-models.why_it_matters: Enterprise adoption is moving past the hype phase into measurable business outcomes.

foundation-models.title: Bringing GPT-Rosalind to academic research labs
foundation-models.summary: OpenAI has introduced the Rosalind Academic Plan, which provides eligible research labs with sponsored access to the GPT-Rosalind model and specialized tools for life sciences research.
foundation-models.why_it_matters: Access to high-tier models is accelerating scientific discovery in academia.

hardware.title: Meta launches an open-weight AI model that runs on Macs
hardware.summary: Meta and Apple have collaborated to release the 'Muse Spark' open-weight AI model, which is capable of running locally on Apple's desktop hardware.
hardware.why_it_matters: Local execution of high-performance models removes data privacy concerns and cloud dependency.

tools.title: Withings now charges $100 per year to sync your data to other apps
tools.summary: Withings is now requiring new users to pay a $100 annual subscription fee to sync health data from their wearables to third-party services like Apple Health or Google Health.
tools.why_it_matters: The change marks a significant shift in data interoperability monetization for consumer health devices.
